visual.general_description: Two grayscale MRI panels: panel A is a head slice with two arrows at bright regions; panel B is an axial band through both orbits with an arrow at each optic nerve.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (left) is a coronal-appearing head MRI slice with two black arrows pointing at saturated bright regions. Panel B (right) is a cropped axial band through both orbits with a white arrow on each side at the optic nerve. Both panels have black backgrounds and printed panel letters only; no other text, scale bar or sequence label is printed.

panels.general_description: Grayscale MRI slice of the head on a black background, panel label "A." at upper left. The slice appears to be in a coronal plane: the cerebral hemispheres with dark lateral ventricles lie above the paired cerebellar hemispheres, with scalp and skull soft tissue around the edge. Two black arrows point to saturated bright white regions, one in the upper part of the image to the right of midline beside a ventricle and one in the central deep region lower down near the midline.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale MRI slice of the head on a black background, panel label "A." at upper left. The slice appears to be in a coronal plane: the cerebral hemispheres with dark lateral ventricles lie above the paired cerebellar hemispheres, with scalp and skull soft tissue around the edge. Two black arrows point to saturated bright white regions, one in the upper part of the image to the right of midline beside a ventricle and one in the central deep region lower down near the midline. The bright regions are irregular and clearly brighter than the surrounding grey brain. No text other than the panel letter, no scale bar and no sequence name are printed. The sequence and the left/right orientation of the image are not labelled.

panels.detailed_description: Grayscale MRI slice on a black background, panel label "B." at upper left. A fan-shaped cropped region near the middle of the image shows an axial section through both orbits, with two rounded globes on either side of a central midline structure. A white arrow points at the posterior part of each globe where the optic nerve lies. The lower and upper parts of the frame are black, so only a narrow band of the head is shown. The nerves are marked by arrows on both sides; the image is small and low resolution so nerve calibre and signal cannot be judged reliably. No text other than the panel letter, no scale bar and no sequence name are printed.
